name: Process historian
short_description: A plant system (operational historian) that stores time-stamped process records from production equipment and is often an existing source for machine data.

evidence.quote: A historian which stores time based process records, might already receive the fillers status
A plant historian, which stores time stamped process records
It should not become a shadow scatter system, a machine historian, or a place where every PLC state gets copied
Then you've got a historian holding years of process values and alarms
